title: WarpOS Sprint v0.2 — Sprint Retrospective
description: Per-sprint analytical artifact written by /sprint:retrospective. Lives at paths.sprintHistory/<sprint-id>/retro.yaml alongside the frozen sprint-history.yaml. Sibling to sprint-history.schema.json — history is the registry of closed sprints (frozen archive), retro is the analytical synthesis (wins, misses, friction, action items). See PRD SP-20260513-004 Design Decision #1.

sprint_id.description: Sprint this retro belongs to. Must match an entry in paths.sprintActiveRegistry or a sprint already moved to paths.sprintHistory.

plan_contract_id.description: Plan Contract id (PC-YYYYMMDD-NNNN) the sprint was planned against. May be null when --no-plan-contract was passed for a legacy/imported sprint.

synthesis_mode.description: How this retro's body was produced. `llm` = synthesized from tracker evidence via paths.sprintRouting#policies.release. `skeleton` = placeholder content emitted via --no-synth or a synthesis-failure fallback. /sprint:retrospective --retry-synth only proceeds when this field is `skeleton`.

summary.description: One-paragraph overview of how the sprint went. Section heading: `## Summary` per COPY C-1.

outcomes_shipped.description: Outcomes the sprint actually delivered. Each item ties back to a ticket, release record, or merged PR. Section heading: `## Outcomes Shipped vs Planned` per COPY C-1.

outcomes_missed.description: Outcomes the Plan Contract or PRD scoped that did NOT ship. Section heading: `## Outcomes Shipped vs Planned` per COPY C-1.

plan_quality_actual.description: Predictions-vs-reality comparison against plan_quality in the Plan Contract. Section heading: `## Plan Quality — Predictions vs Reality` per COPY C-1.

predicted_status.description: plan_quality.status from the Plan Contract at /sprint:plan time.

actual_status.description: How the plan actually held up in execution: held|drifted|broke|unknown.

scope_variant_actual.description: Which scope variant the plan picked vs which actually shipped. Section heading: `## Scope Variant Adherence` per COPY C-1.

surprises.description: Things the team did not anticipate at /sprint:plan time. Section heading: `## Surprises` per COPY C-1.

friction_points.description: Specific points of friction during the sprint — what slowed work down. Section heading: `## Friction Points` per COPY C-1.

action_items.description: Concrete changes to apply in the next sprint. Section heading: `## Action Items for Next Sprint` per COPY C-1.

issues_encountered.description: Issues opened during the sprint. Section heading: `## Issues Encountered` per COPY C-1.

beta_decisions_reviewed.description: Beta judgment-model decisions that mattered this sprint. Section heading: `## Beta Decisions Reviewed` per COPY C-1.

key_tradeoffs.description: Decisions where two paths existed and we picked one. Section heading: `## Key Tradeoffs` per COPY C-1.

learning_candidates.description: Lessons worth promoting to paths.learningsFile via /learn:integrate. Retros do NOT auto-promote — this is a candidate list. Section heading: `## Learning Candidates` per COPY C-1.

release_record_ref.description: Release id (RL-YYYYMMDD-NNN) tied to this sprint, when one exists.

synthesis_metadata.description: Bookkeeping for the synthesis call itself — model class used, duration, fallback reasons. Read by future /check:patterns cross-sprint trend analysis.

signed_off_by.description: Who signed off on the retro. Defaults to `alpha` when the script writes it. Operator can amend to `user` after review.

retro_metadata.description: Misc bookkeeping — when the retro was synthesized, the script version, related history file pointer.
